title: Templates for this module
body: Copy-ready structures you can reuse in your own engagements. Examples are fictional.

lines.label: Fields
lines.text: Claim, source passage/date, factual/inference/unknown, access class, capability verified, unit check, reviewer, clearance, action

lines.label: Fictional example
lines.text: A generated timing without a source fails baseline review and is marked unverified.

lines.label: Acceptance check
lines.text: No invented facts, automated approvals, restricted data disclosure or unsupported external claims.
